description: Land Acquisition - Medabedda, Ralangoda D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Amendment to the Notice Published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1852/37 of 06.03.2014 by Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose, including lot numbers, land names, claimants, and extents. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters, property ownership claims, and compensation procedures for acquired land.
